test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which ministry organized ‘Nari Shakti of North East’ on the occasion of International Women’s Day 2022?

options.text: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
__
 
• The correct answer is the **Ministry of Development of the North Eastern Region**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Nari Shakti of North East" is a celebration of the power and strength of women in the northeastern region of India.
 
• The event is usually held on** International Women's Day, which is on March 8th every year** and is organized by the **Ministry of Development of the North Eastern Region (DoNER)**.
 
• The event is aimed at recognizing the contributions and achievements of women in the northeastern region of India.
 
• It provides a platform for women to showcase their talents, skills, and achievements in various fields, **including arts, culture, sports, and entrepreneurship**.
 
• The event includes various activities such as panel discussions, cultural performances, exhibitions, and award ceremonies.
 
• The award ceremony recognizes women who have made significant contributions in various fields and includes categories such as **entrepreneurship, education, social work, and sports**.
 
• The event also provides an opportunity for women to interact and network with each other and share their experiences and challenges.
 
• The "Nari Shakti of North East" celebration is an important initiative that highlights the role of women in the development of the northeastern region of India.
 
• It is also a way to promote gender equality and empowerment and to inspire and motivate more women to pursue their dreams and aspirations.
